jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
ITAC serves Process & Industrial clients with integrated engineering and construction services for complex capital projects. We also offer specialty services including power systems services and products, custom machine fabrication, and fall protection services and equipment. Founded in 1988 on a dream and a $5K loan, ITAC is a true success story. From humble beginnings to an ENR-Ranked Top Design Firm with a nationwide footprint and over 450 employees operating from 6 offices in Virginia, North Carolina, and South Carolina, we provide Fortune 500 companies with innovative design-build solutions. We specialize in power generation & utilities, chemicals, food & beverage, forest products, advanced manufacturing, and minerals & metals.

ITAC's purpose is to make life better. For our employees, this means providing them with the resources and flexibility they need to have both a rewarding career and a fulfilling family life. ITAC is 100% employee-owned. Through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) and Direct Stock Ownership, every team member has the unique opportunity to be an owner who shares in the company's growth and earnings. We offer our team a comprehensive benefits package and numerous employee incentives. Rooted in love, we serve and care for our employees like family.

We hire passionate and motivated people with an innovative mindset and the desire to grow. If the thought of challenging, fast-paced projects excites you, then you've come to the right place. At ITAC, you'll be part of a collaborative team that works hard to make life better. For more information, visit itac.us.com.

This is a seconded position, meaning the selected candidate will be employed by ITAC but work full-time on assignment with one of our clients. While day-to-day responsibilities will be managed on-site with the client, ITAC provides ongoing support, resources, and benefits as your employer.Please only apply if these requirements are agreeable to you.

Objective

We are seeking a Project Manager
to join our team. This role is pivotal in leading an industrial project development, execution, ensuring technical excellence, compliance with contractual obligations, and alignment with client objectives. The position involves managing scope, schedule, and budget, coordinating engineering and construction resources, and driving project success through proactive leadership and client engagement.

Responsibilities

Project Management

Lead project development efforts, including scope definition, cost estimating, and scheduling
Direct engineering, procurement, and construction teams during project execution to meet contractual commitments
Develop and maintain project schedules, ensuring proper resource allocation and timely delivery
Manage project budgets, track financial performance, and negotiate change requests with clients
Ensure quality standards are met across all deliverables and services

Client Relations & Business Development

Cultivate strong client relationships and maintain clear communication on project progress
Address project and client issues promptly and professionally
Support business development by pursuing new opportunities and assisting with proposals and pricing

Administrative

Prepare proposals, execution plans, and project documentation
Participate in professional development activities and contribute to company growth initiatives
Promote and enforce Assured Project Management (APM) principles and company standards

Requirements

Education

Bachelor of Science degree from an ABET-accredited institution in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Architecture, or equivalent experience
Management degree preferred but not required

Experience

10+ years in engineering, construction, or project management roles within the Industrial space (increasing with seniority)
Multidiscipline project design experience
Demonstrated experience in electric vehicle (EV) systems and advanced battery technologies, including design, integration, and performance optimization
Familiarity with commissioning, startup, and construction support tasks
Proven ability to manage complex projects and lead diverse teams
Experience in manufacturing and industrial construction environment
Experience in overseeing industrial projects from conception and design to completion and startup.

Skills

Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and project management tools
Strong organizational and planning abilities
Excellent written and oral communication skills
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues under pressure
Leadership qualities with the ability to teach and mentor others

Certifications

PMP or Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred for senior-level positions

Benefits

From internships to seasoned professionals, our growing company provides career opportunities for all levels of experience. We offer our team a comprehensive benefits package and numerous employee incentives. For life's challenges, we also provide our employees and their immediate families with certified chaplains for around-the-clock encouragement and support. Rooted in love, we serve and care for our employees like family. ITAC provides benefits such as

Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance
401k & ESOP
Life Insurance
Short & Long-Term Disability
Paid Time Off
Paid Holidays
Employee Assistance Program
Professional Development
Wellness Program
Safety Incentive Program
24/7 Chaplain Care

jobs.description:
About Us

At BCD Meetings & Events (BCD M&E), we provide more than meeting and event planning services: we create connections that inspire, motivate and change behavior for our customers. As the world’s most trusted and innovative meetings and events agency, BCD M&E cultivates a culture of people, passion and purpose to drive business forward.

Headquartered in Chicago, with locations in 60+ countries across the world, BCD M&E’s team of 2,000+ people are committed to sustainability and driving success for our customers, our business and ourselves. Our values are at the heart of everything we do, and we look for people that want to be a part of something special, can rise to our standards and love to bring their unique perspective to the table.

While we can’t guarantee every day will be the best (who can?), we can promise a community of people who genuinely care and lead with empathy, a flexible workplace with awesome perks and challenging work that means something.

See what life is about at BCD M&E at bcdme.com/careers

Projectmanager Meetings, BCD Meetings & Events België

Fulltime | Homebased in België

Ben jij een sterke organisator met feeling voor hospitality, events en klantrelaties? Dan is deze rol als Projectmanager Meetings bij BCD Meetings & Events België misschien wel iets voor jou.

Als projectmanager ben jij de schakel tussen de meeting planner van de klant en het hotel of de leverancier. Je begeleidt het traject van locatiesearch en contractering tot en met de planningsfase van de bijeenkomst. Daarbij bouw je sterke klantrelaties op en zorg je ervoor dat alles vlot, professioneel en tot in de puntjes verloopt.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onder andere locatieonderzoek, selectie, offerteaanvragen, budgettering, onderhandelingen, contractafsluiting en het in kaart brengen van besparingen. Afhankelijk van het programma kunnen daar ook taken bij komen zoals deelnemersregistratie, websiteontwikkeling, programmaorganisatie, on-site ondersteuning en afstemming met alle betrokken partijen.

De programma’s waaraan je werkt, variëren van 10 tot 500 deelnemers. Je komt terecht in een team met open communicatielijnen en een flexibele manier van samenwerken. Tegelijk neem jij eigenaarschap over je projecten en zorg je ervoor dat processen correct worden gevolgd en dat jij voor jouw klant dé expert bent.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Je onderzoekt de beschikbaarheid van hotels en locaties op basis van de specificaties van het programma.
Je stelt, waar nodig via meetingtechnologie, voorlopige tarieven, beschikbaarheidsoverzichten en programmabudgetten op om de klant te ondersteunen bij de keuze van de juiste locatie.
Je onderhandelt contracten met hotels en locaties.
Je bespreekt en onderhandelt aanvullende, klantspecifieke voorwaarden met leveranciers en venues.
Je werkt samen met de klant rond het betalen van hotelvoorschotten.
Je onderhoudt dagelijks je relaties binnen de sector.
Je maakt optimaal gebruik van de voorkeursafspraken van klanten met hotels tijdens contractonderhandelingen.
Je plant en woont, indien nodig, bezoeken aan leveranciers bij.
Je bewaakt de kwaliteit en correctheid van technologische gegevens.
Je onderzoekt voorkeursleveranciers voor offerteaanvragen en formuleert indien nodig aanbevelingen.
Je volgt hotelovernachtingen, uitgaven en gerealiseerde besparingen op en rapporteert hierover nauwkeurig.

Jij brengt mee

Bij voorkeur een bacheloropleiding of gelijkwaardige ervaring, idealiter met een zakelijke insteek en ondernemende mindset.
Ervaring in de eventsector; kennis van Cvent is een mooie plus.
Inzicht in verschillende soorten meetings en de specifieke aandachtspunten die daarbij horen.
Een goede algemene kennis van bestemmingen, hotels en leveranciers.
Sterke mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands, Engels en Frans.
Ervaring binnen een bureau gespecialiseerd in meeting management is een extra troef.
Ervaring met klanten uit de farmaceutische sector is een plus.

Wat je mag verwachten Voor deze functie ligt het bruto jaarsalaris tussen €40.000 en €50.000, afhankelijk van je ervaring, skills en kwalificaties.

De sollicitatiegesprekken vinden plaats in de tweede helft van augustus.

________________________________________________________________________

Project Manager Meetings Management, BCD Meetings & Events Belgium

Full-time, (home) based in Belgium

The Project Manager owns and manages client relationships and will serve as the liaison between the clients meeting planner and the hotel/supplier during the sourcing and contracting phase of the meeting and during the planning phase.

You are primarily responsible for site research, selection, RFP development, value-added client counseling, budgeting, negotiations, contracting, and savings consolidation. Additional responsibilities may include attendee registration, website development, program organization, onsite management, and reconciliation.

Programs will vary in scopes and sizes from 10 attendees to 500 attendees. Communication lines within the team are open and flexible, and you will be responsible for following all processes appropriately and being your Client's subject matter expert.

Your Responsibilities

Source hotel/venue availability based on the program specifications. Provide (via meetings technology) preliminary rate, availability grids, and preliminary program budgets, as required to assist the Client meeting sponsor in making a final decision on program location.
Negotiate hotel and venue contracts.
Effectively be able to negotiate Client specific addendum with vendors and venues.
Work with the Client on hotel deposit payments.
Manage day-to-day industry relationships.
Utilize and leverage Client preferred hotel agreements when negotiating hotel contracts.
Schedule and attend supplier visits as required.
Ensure technology data integrity.
Research preferred suppliers to include in RFP responses and provide recommendations

potentially.

Track and report hotel room nights, spending, and savings; ensure technology data integrity.

You're good at

BA preferred or similar level of experience with a business focus and entrepreneurial spirit.
Prior event experience and Cvent knowledge is preferred
Understanding of meeting types and associated considerations
General understanding of destinations, hotels, and suppliers
Excellent oral and written communication skills in English, Dutch and French
Agency experience in the meetings management fields is a plus
Experience with pharma clients is preferred

The salary range for the role is between 40.000 euro and 50.000 euro gross per year. The actual pay will depends on your qualifications, skills and experience.

Interviews will take place in the third week of August.

THE PERKS

Flexible Working

We believe that a flexible working environment is key to getting the best out of our teams. We will support you to work where you need to and when you need to, depending on how you work best.

Room to Grow

Our line of work and business structure challenge our people in a way that inspires growth, with learning and development built into every role. We give individuals ownership over the direction and speed in which they grow.

Everyone has a voice

We thrive on conversations that spark curiosity and empathy. No matter how big or how small, every voice is heard, considered and respected.

Make your move

The diversity of roles across BCD M&E’s global locations means that our people often find new adventures during their time with us. Join us as a meeting planner role in the UK, stay for a global marketing career — there’s always room to move.

We’ve got you covered

Our extensive benefits include comprehensive healthcare, retirement plans, continued education support, diverse work locations, travel and hotel discounts, volunteer and sustainability opportunities and a successful employee recognition program.

We’re positive. You’ll love it.

It starts from the top. Our leaders lead with positivity, believe in our people and trust us to do the right thing. There will always be support along your journey, in little and big ways.

Description

Project Manager I, RWE

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

The Project Manager is responsible for leading Real-World Evidence (RWE) research projects from initiation through delivery, partnering closely with clients, epidemiologists, research teams, and biostatisticians to ensure successful project execution.

This role combines project leadership, scientific understanding, and client consulting. The successful candidate will not only manage timelines and deliverables but will also provide strategic recommendations, facilitate client discussions, proactively solve problems, and contribute to the overall success of RWE research programs.

The ideal candidate brings experience in Real-World Evidence, health research, consulting, or other highly client-facing environments and is comfortable navigating ambiguity while managing multiple stakeholders.

Ideal Background

3-4 years of project management, consulting, or research management experience
Experience supporting Real-World Evidence (RWE) projects
Experience with database studies, qualitative research, quantitative research, and interview-based studies
Scientific background in Epidemiology, Public Health, Health Sciences, Life Sciences, or related fields
Strong client-facing and consulting skills
Experience presenting recommendations and guiding decision-making discussions
Ability to work effectively with epidemiologists, biostatisticians, and research teams
Comfortable working in a global and cross-functional environment

Important Note for Applicants

This position is focused on Real-World Evidence (RWE) research
and is not a traditional clinical trial management role
. Candidates whose experience is primarily focused on Phase I-III clinical trials, CRA activities, site monitoring, or clinical operations may not be the best fit unless they also have substantial exposure to Real-World Evidence research and consulting-based project delivery.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Committed to and responsible for Envirocon’s Safety Culture & actively involved in project Health and Safety, including:

We Put the World on Vacation

Travel + Leisure Co. is the world’s leading vacation ownership and travel membership company, with a dynamic and growing portfolio of resort, travel club, and lifestyle travel brands. Our dedicated associates help the company achieve its mission to put the world on vacation. Innovation and growth keep our work interesting and fun. Every day is a chance to learn something new and turn vacation inspiration into exceptional experiences for millions of travelers worldwide.

Lead. Deliver. Transform.

Are you an experienced Project Manager who thrives on taking ownership, solving problems and seeing projects through from concept to completion?

Travel + Leisure Co. is seeking a highly motivated Project Manager – Hotel Refurbishment & Projects
to join our Refurbishment & Projects team and deliver a diverse portfolio of hotel, resort and commercial refurbishment projects across Australia and internationally.

This is an opportunity to play a key role in transforming our resort portfolio and delivering projects that directly enhance the guest experience.

The Opportunity

This is a hands-on, end-to-end project delivery role
.

You will take responsibility for assigned refurbishment and capital projects from initial scoping and feasibility through design, procurement, construction, commissioning and final handover to Resort Operations.

Working closely with Resort Managers, internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors, suppliers and trades, you will be responsible for delivering projects safely, efficiently, on time and within approved budgets.

You will be expected to take ownership of your projects, identify issues early, develop solutions and drive delivery rather than simply administer the process.

What you’ll be doing

Lead refurbishment and construction projects from inception through to completion and operational handover.
Develop project scopes, budgets, programmes and procurement strategies.
Engage and manage architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, suppliers and specialist trades.
Prepare and manage tenders, quotations and construction contracts.
Negotiate commercial outcomes and manage contractor performance.
Monitor project costs, commitments, forecasts and variations.
Identify opportunities for value engineering and cost savings.
Manage construction programmes and critical path activities.
Conduct regular site inspections and maintain a hands-on understanding of project progress.
Coordinate works within operational hotels and resorts while minimising disruption to guests and Resort Operations.
Manage quality, safety, compliance, defects and practical completion.
Resolve construction issues, latent conditions and project risks.
Provide accurate project reporting, forecasting and financial control.
Successfully hand over completed projects to Resort Operations.

About You

You are a self-starter who takes ownership
.

You don’t wait for problems to resolve themselves and you don’t need to be constantly directed. You are comfortable making decisions, coordinating multiple stakeholders and driving projects forward in challenging environments.

You Will Ideally Bring

Proven experience delivering refurbishment and construction projects from inception to completion.
Strong hotel, resort, hospitality, commercial or accommodation refurbishment experience.
Excellent knowledge of construction processes, building practices and project delivery.
Strong tendering, procurement and contract administration experience.
Demonstrated commercial and budget management capability.
Proven ability to manage contractors, consultants, suppliers and trades.
Strong planning, programming and organisational skills.
Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
A practical, solutions-focused approach.
High attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture.
The ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively with a broader team.
Relevant tertiary qualifications in Construction, Building, Engineering, Architecture, Project Management or a related discipline are desirable; equivalent industry experience will be considered.

National & International Travel

Travel Is An Essential Part Of This Role.

The successful candidate must be comfortable undertaking significant national and international travel
, including extended periods working on site at resorts and project locations.

This is not a traditional office-based Project Manager role. You will need to be comfortable being where the project is, sometimes for extended periods, and working closely with Resort Operations, contractors and trades to achieve successful project outcomes.

Why join us?

You’ll join a team delivering a significant portfolio of refurbishment and capital projects across a leading global vacation ownership and resort organisation.

You Will Have The Opportunity To

Work on a diverse portfolio of resort and hospitality projects.
Take genuine ownership of projects from start to finish.
Work across Australia and internationally.
Collaborate with experienced property, development, procurement and resort teams.
Make a tangible difference to the guest experience.
Be part of a business that puts the world on vacation.

If you’re a commercially minded, hands-on Project Manager who enjoys being accountable for getting things done, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and tell us about the refurbishment projects you’ve delivered and the outcomes you achieved.

jobs.description:
About Samsung C&T Corporation

Samsung C&T Corporation was founded in 1938 and is the parent company of Samsung Group. It is a Global Business Partner and Lifestyle Innovator pioneering new trends in the construction, trading & investment, fashion and resort industries. Its Trading & Investment Group operates in over 40 countries managing energy projects
and industrial commodities (chemicals, steel, materials). It acts as a specialized trader and developer, focusing on renewable energy (solar/wind/ESS), LNG and new business ventures such as data centers.

In the United States, Samsung C&T Renewables
has a track record of developing over 38GW of renewable energy projects since 2016. Headquartered in Houston, Texas, it currently manages a 20GW+ PV/BESS pipeline across 24 states, backed by a solid team of 100+ employees across the US and Seoul, South Korea. In addition, it has full development cycle capabilities, including in-house site acquisition, real estate, permitting, interconnection, engineering, pre-construction and much more.
In Canada, Samsung has successfully developed, constructed, and continues to manage operation services for a 1.3GW solar+wind energy cluster.

🔎 About the Role

Samsung C&T is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead utility-scale solar PV and battery energy storage (BESS) projects from mid/late-stage development through NTP, construction, and COD. As an owner-side Sr.PM for a developer/IPP, you will coordinate internal teams and external EPCs/contractors and consultants to ensure projects are bankable at NTP and successfully delivered in the field.
This is a remote role with periodic travel (typically monthly site visits plus key milestones) to project sites, EPC offices, and occasional in-person team meetings.

🛠 Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Project Leadership (Owner-Side)

Serve as the primary owner representative and single point of accountability for assigned projects from mid/late-stage development through COD.
Lead cross-functional coordination between Development, Engineering, Interconnection, Legal, Procurement, Construction Management, Finance, and Operations.
Establish and maintain project execution plans, defining scope, schedule, budget, and risk profile aligned with portfolio and financing requirements.

2. Pre-Construction & Development Support

Support mid/late-stage development with scope definition, basis of design, and execution strategy for utility-scale PV and BESS projects.
Help coordinate internal and external engineers to ensure bankable, constructible design packages that comply with applicable codes and utility interconnection requirements.
Review and challenge EPC assumptions on design, means and methods, productivity, and logistics.
Participate in site due diligence (desk-based and periodic site visits) including layout optimization, access and logistics, and early constructability reviews.
Support M&A and greenfield development by providing CAPEX/ schedule input and reviewing technical due diligence materials.

3. Budgeting, Estimating & EPC/Contract Support

Work with estimating and EPC partners to develop and validate project budgets and CAPEX for investment decisions and NTP approvals.
Lead preparation and management of RFPs for EPC packages; support Procurement Team with RFPs for major equipment, including scope definitions, bid evaluations and recommendations.
Lead negotiating EPC Contracts, and assist with key supplier contracts, providing technical and commercial input to ensure alignment with project risks and financing conditions.
Track and communicate key commercial assumptions (contingency, escalation, allowances) to internal stakeholders.

4. Scheduling & Portfolio Coordination

Develop and maintain high-level integrated project schedules from mid/late-stage development through COD, aligned with portfolio and financing timelines.
Coordinate with EPCs on detailed construction schedules and monitor critical path activities, especially interconnection, long-lead procurement, and commissioning.
Ensure project schedules tie into portfolio milestones (NTP, COD, tax credit deadlines, lender milestones).

5. Construction Oversight (Monthly Site Visits)

Provide owner-side oversight of EPC/contractor performance, primarily through remote coordination plus monthly site visits and targeted milestone visits (mobilization, mechanical completion, energization, performance testing).
Review EPC reports, three-week look-ahead, manpower curves, and progress photos; challenge and validate reported progress and forecasts.
Participate in regular construction progress calls and meetings, ensuring safety, quality, and schedule expectations are clearly communicated and enforced.
During site visits, perform field walks with EPC and owner’s engineer to validate progress, quality, and compliance with contract documents.

6. Cost Control, Change Management & Reporting

Own the project budget from NTP through COD on the owner side, maintaining up-to-date forecasts and contingency positions.
Evaluate and negotiate EPC and supplier change orders, aligning with contract terms and protecting project economics.
Develop and deliver monthly project reports covering schedule, cost, risks, safety, and key decisions for internal leadership and investment committees.
Coordinate with Finance on drawdowns, cash flow forecasts, and lender reporting requirements.

7. Quality, Commissioning & Turnover to Operations

Coordinate with the EPC, Owner’s Engineer, and internal technical teams on QA/QC, inspections, and testing.
Oversee commissioning plans, performance testing, and punch list closeout to meet contractual and financing requirements.
Ensure delivery of complete as-built documentation, test reports, warranties, O&M manuals, and spare parts as required by contracts and lenders.
Lead project handover to Asset Management/O&M, including lessons learned and long-term risk items.

8. Risk Management, Compliance & Stakeholder Interface

Maintain and actively manage a project risk register from mid/late-stage development through COD, with mitigation strategies and action owners.
Coordinate with utilities, AHJs, landowners, and community stakeholders as needed, usually in partnership with Development and Construction Management.
Ensure compliance with environmental permits, interconnection agreements, and lender requirements.

🎯 Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Engineering, Construction Management, or related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
10+ years of experience in project management, pre-construction, or construction management for utility-scale solar and/or BESS projects (≥20 MWac), including time in an owner, IPP, or developer environment or closely interfacing with one.
Demonstrated experience managing projects through both:
Pre-construction (design coordination, estimating/budgeting, contracting), and
Construction/commissioning oversight (schedule, cost, quality, and turnover).
Strong understanding of EPC delivery models, contract structures, and risk allocation on large power projects.
Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Primavera P6 or MS Project for schedules; Excel, and a PM platform such as ProCore for tracking and reporting).
Excellent remote communication skills, able to lead distributed teams and manage EPCs largely from afar with targeted site visits.
Ability and willingness to travel approximately once per month to project sites and occasional in-person meetings (overall ~15 - 25% travel).

Preferred
Experience in a developer/IPP role directly interfacing with investors, lenders, and tax equity partners.
Familiarity with project finance, NTP and COD conditions, and lender/IE processes.
Experience overseeing BESS integration and commissioning alongside PV.
Professional certifications such as PMP, PE, or CCM.

Competencies

Owner’s mindset – focused on long-term asset performance, not just project completion.
Strong commercial and technical acumen, able to interrogate EPC assumptions and protect project value.
Comfortable working remotely with multiple time zones, using structured communication and clear documentation.
Skilled at building constructive relationships with EPCs, suppliers, and internal stakeholders while holding them accountable.
Highly organized, with strong prioritization and follow-through, especially across multiple projects in a portfolio.
Deep commitment to safety, quality, and ethical conduct.

💡 Why Join Samsung C&T

Work with a global team delivering innovative, large‑scale energy solutions.
Competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for international collaboration.
Work with a global organization committed to innovation and sustainability
Opportunities for professional growth in a dynamic, mission‑driven environment

jobs.title: AI Legal Program Manager
jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.
The Role
As AI Legal Program Manager, you will play a key role in navigating the legal and regulatory landscape of Block's artificial intelligence initiatives. You will partner with legal, engineering, product, and compliance teams to develop frameworks that enable responsible AI innovation while ensuring regulatory compliance and risk management across our AI products and services.
You will:
Drive the development and implementation of AI legal and compliance frameworks, including policies for model development, deployment, and monitoring that align with emerging AI regulations and industry standards.
Participate in cross-functional reviews of AI project initiatives to identify legal risks and opportunities, ensuring compliance with regulations while enabling innovation.
Develop and maintain AI governance documentation, including model cards, algorithmic impact assessments, training data compliance records, and legal risk assessments.
Partner with engineering teams to implement legally compliant AI development practices, including requirements for transparency, fairness, and accountability.
Create and maintain processes for AI incident response, model monitoring, and legal compliance validation.
Build scalable processes for AI legal reviews across various stakeholders.

You have:
5+ years of directly related experience in technical program management, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML initiatives in a technology-driven environment.
Strong understanding of emerging AI regulations (EU AI Act, state AI laws, etc.) and their practical implementation.
Experience developing legal frameworks for AI governance and responsible AI development.
Track record of partnering with technical teams to implement legal requirements in AI systems.
Understanding of IP considerations in AI development, including training data rights, model ownership, and output licensing.
Experience with AI risk assessment methodologies and mitigation strategies.
Strong project management skills with experience leading cross-functional initiatives.

Even better:
Experience with large language models (LLMs) and generative AI legal considerations
Background in open source software licensing and AI model licensing
Familiarity with AI ethics frameworks and algorithmic fairness principles
Experience with AI procurement and vendor assessment
Knowledge of global AI regulatory developments and policy trends
Background in privacy law and data protection regulations
Technical background or demonstrated ability to understand AI/ML concept

The Professional Billing Revenue Cycle Program Manager:

Leads the planning, coordination, and execution of professional billing revenue cycle programs to ensure efficient, compliant, and high-performing financial operations across the organization. Serves as the primary liaison of the PB revenue cycle team to designated clinical teams, building and managing strategic relationships with clinic administrators, physicians, and departmental leadership to drive alignment, transparency, and results.
Partners cross-functionally with clinical, operational, and finance stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and resolve revenue cycle optimization opportunities, including charge capture improvement, denial reduction, workflow standardization, and system enhancements. Leads the planning, execution, and ongoing management of revenue cycle programs and initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational financial goals, operational priorities, and centralized revenue cycle strategies
Facilitates cross-functional collaboration across clinical, operational, finance, and IT teams to identify, prioritize, and implement revenue cycle optimization opportunities, including charge capture improvement, denial reduction, workflow redesign, and system enhancements.

jobs.description:
Responsible for providing oversight and leadership necessary for successful implementation of designated projects, initiatives, and/or studies of a complex nature, including those that are multi-year, multi-site, or involve multiple stakeholders. Supports leaders and investigators to effectively manage scope, deliverables, timelines, and budget. Areas of responsibility include organizing and leading project meetings; preparing reports, presentations and timelines; feasibility assessment; data evaluation; direct project management including budget management in accordance with grant and/or contract requirements.

Major Responsibilities

Leads the planning, execution, and oversight of AARI projects, initiatives, and/or multi-year, multi-site, multi-stakeholder pragmatic clinical trials and research studies; collectively referred to as “project(s)”.
Manages project timelines to ensure that project goals and deliverables (including reports, study subject recruitment) are met on time.
Tracks the execution of projects against project timelines and communicates project status to internal and external collaborators. Creates and delivers customized project plans, project charters, reports and presentations. Updates and ensures timely and effective deployment of implementation plans and measurable returns.
Oversees project activities assigned to research personnel and works closely with project team to develop and implement strategies to achieve project objectives, improve efficiency of research processes and procedures (including recruitment), and subsequently execute improvements, working with leaders as appropriate.
Manages project plans, project meetings, and agendas for project teams working with clinical and research leaders, investigators, clinical staff, other internal stakeholders (including IT), and external collaborators in academia and industry.
Independently builds relationships with research teams and collaborating institutions and assists in the development of new project proposals, including working closely with Sponsored Program Services, legal, privacy, compliance, and IT to secure appropriate administrative approvals.
Ensures that all study activities are completed by strictly following Good Clinical Practices (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines, Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), institutional and departmental research guidelines (e.g., IRB), and federal, state, and local agencies.

Education Required

Master's Degree in Business or related field, or
Master's Degree in Health Science or related field.

Experience Required

Typically requires 5 years of experience in research project or program management in a large health care system, industry or academic environment.

Preferred Qualifications/Experience

Experience building collaborations and overseeing research teams in academic medical settings
Experience working with NIH-, PCORI-, or other federally funded research programs (including communication with and reporting to safety monitors/officers)
Proficiency with REDCap, including data entry, creating databases and questionnaires, survey management, and developing reports/custom dashboards
Proficiency with Microsoft365 products, including use of Excel to develop pivot tables and reports, and/or basic skills related to using at least one statistical software package (e.g., SPSS, SAS, or R)
Proficiency with Epic for participant identification, recruitment, study implementation, and data collection activities
Familiarity with Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS) such as OnCore
Experience with developing and implementing plans to recruit and retain community and patient populations in trials with multi-year follow-ups
Experience with reviewing, reading, and summarizing scientific literature, especially literature focused in the areas of health behavior change, weight management, nutrition, physical activity, cardiovascular disease, and/or type 2 diabetes
Experience managing data capture related to dietary intake and physical activity, especially using newer technologies (e.g., via the NCI ASA24, smartphone apps, wearable devices)

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required

Knowledge of health services research including subject recruitment and consenting processes.
Ability to problem solve, work independently with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, organizational and time management skills with ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Skilled in identifying opportunities to improve efficiency of research processes and procedures and subsequently execute improvement.
Ability to provide effective leadership and motivate others. Ability to mentor staff and prepare training plans.
Experience managing diverse clinical and research teams.
Experience in project management and ability to drive progress in complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives.

Physical Requirements And Working Conditions

Will generally be exposed to rapid-pace and complex health care environment.
Remote work with in-person presence (e.g., site visits, recruitment activities, meetings) as needed.
This position may require ability to drive and/or travel to work related meetings/functions and thus is exposed to road, weather, and normal travel hazards.

Join the Workforce Staffing (WFS) Transformation team in driving the future of WFS through data-driven program execution, process engineering, and strategic analysis. This role sits at the intersection of program management and deep data analytics. You will own the strategy, execution, and delivery of programs that leverage advanced analytics, generative AI, and process engineering to drive measurable business outcomes. You'll translate complex data into actionable insights, build scalable solutions, and drive progress across cross-functional teams—operating with ambiguity and owning outcomes end-to-end. The ideal candidate is a creative, demonstrated leader with superior ability to learn new technology and make data-driven decisions for project deliverables.

This is an opportunity to operate in a fast-paced environment where innovation meets scale. You'll develop deep expertise in workforce analytics and process engineering while contributing to mission-critical hiring operations that directly impact our ability to serve customers worldwide. Key job responsibilities

Drive end-to-end program execution for data analytics and process engineering initiatives across global workforce staffing operations (1M+ hires, 5M+ applications annually across the globe)

jobs.description:
Description

If you've ever wondered how Amazon knows what millions of sellers need and whether the changes we make improve their experience, that's the work our team does.

We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to own and drive our cross-organizational SP Satisfaction strategy and deliver measurable seller experience improvements. This role requires you to define program direction, work independently across organizations, influence Director and VP organizations, and translate complex satisfaction data into clear executive narratives that drive action. This role is for someone who thrives at the intersection of data, strategy, and stakeholder influence who can own the accountability framework that ensures the right changes happen and that sellers feel the difference.

The Selling Partner Satisfaction & Strategic Insights (SPSSI) team owns the measurement, research, and strategic insights that inform how Amazon improves the selling experience for over 2 million sellers worldwide. We track satisfaction across every major seller touchpoint, identify what's driving dissatisfaction, and partner with teams across the organization to turn those insights into measurable improvements.

Key job responsibilities

You Must Be Able To

Define and manage the SP satisfaction program strategy, including goal-setting, roadmap reviews, and escalation when goals are at risk
Own executive-level reporting mechanisms: monthly kingpin goal updates, WBR satisfaction slides, quarterly QBR satisfaction narratives, and CX slide content for CEO/Board-level review
Lead cross-organizational stakeholder engagement with partner teams to align roadmaps and ensure committed actions are delivered on schedule
Translate satisfaction data, verbatim seller feedback, and research findings into clear, seller-backward narratives that senior leaders use to make decisions
Drive the quarterly satisfaction flash synthesizing trends, identifying emerging risks, and providing actionable recommendations to leadership and partner teams
Identify gaps between what partner teams are building and what sellers are telling us, and use data to influence prioritization of seller experience improvements
Coordinate with researchers and data scientists on the team to ensure insights are timely, accurate, and connected to the right stakeholder actions
Partner with the team's Sr. Product Manager and Research Scientists to ensure product strategy aligns with program goals and that measurement capabilities evolve to meet emerging business needs

A day in the life

Your week has a rhythm. You review the latest satisfaction data with the team, identify what moved and why, and prepare WBR callouts. Early in the month, you're updating kingpin goals, writing the status, confirming initiative ECDs with partner teams, and flagging risks before they become misses. You're in regular contact with stakeholders across teams that own satisfaction drivers, not to do their work, but to make sure the satisfaction signals reach the right people and drive the right actions. The problems you'll work on are real and consequential and you drive the strategy that shapes how we improve the business for our Selling Partners.

About The Team

Within Amazon, Selling Partner Services (SPS) enables third-party sellers of any size to build the business they want. The Core Selling Partner Experience (CSPE) team defines, implements, and enforces quality standards for all Amazon-built seller experiences worldwide. SPSSI sits within CSPE and owns the satisfaction measurement infrastructure, strategic research, and goal accountability mechanisms that inform how Amazon improves the seller experience globally.

Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

3+ years of communicating with and presenting to executive and senior audiences experience
3+ years of leading large complex programs experience
Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions
Experience in complex problem solving, and working in a tight schedule environment

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Availability Serviceability Team
jobs.description:
Description

The AWS Data Center Availability Serviceability team works with hundreds of AWS data centers globally to deliver the highest quality and lowest cost availability, capacity, and scaling results for our customers. We standardize operations globally by delivering tools, policy, processes, and procedures to our internal teams.

Serviceability is the ability to maintain, repair, and manage infrastructure assets efficiently throughout their lifecycle -- encompassing maintenance standards, spares management, training and certifications, operational readiness, and the systematic use of data and automation to prevent disruptions and drive continuous improvement.

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to own the MBOM program as part of the AWS Data Center Availability Serviceability Critical Spares team. MBOMs define which parts make up each piece of critical infrastructure equipment and are foundational to programmatic spares planning and fulfillment -- enabling proactive stocking decisions, criticality assessments, and repair readiness across the global fleet.

What You Will Do

You will own the development and delivery of a multi-year roadmap to establish comprehensive MBOM coverage across the global AWS fleet. Working with stakeholders across Field Engineering, DCEO, vendors, and lifecycle data teams, you will scale AI-powered pipelines that extract MBOM data from vendor documentation, define per-equipment MBOM standards, and design the processes for establishing MBOMs where source documentation does not exist. Your work sets the foundation for programmatic spares identification, criticality assessment, and fulfillment -- ensuring the right parts are available at the right locations before failures occur. You will build the mechanisms that keep MBOM data current as the fleet grows, diversifies into new cooling technologies, and introduces new vendors.

Why It Matters

Spares readiness starts with knowing what's inside the equipment. MBOM is the data layer that connects equipment design to spares strategy to repair outcomes. With comprehensive MBOM coverage, we can programmatically identify critical parts, make proactive stocking decisions, and reduce time to repair -- directly improving data center availability for customers.

Why You Will Love It

You will own a program that is genuinely novel -- building something that didn't exist two years ago, using AI tooling that is still maturing, against a problem (fleet-wide MBOM completeness) that no one has solved at this scale. You will operate in high ambiguity with real ownership to define what good looks like. You will work across PLM systems, enterprise asset management, spares strategy, and physical equipment -- giving you breadth that most TPM roles don't offer. And your output has direct, measurable impact: every MBOM you complete makes the fleet more repairable.

Key job responsibilities

Own MBOM program strategy, execution, and completeness metrics across the global fleet
Operate and scale AI-assisted pipelines that convert vendor documentation into governed MBOM records
Define and execute the process for establishing MBOMs where vendor documentation is limited or unavailable
Ensure MBOM data flows into criticality assessments and stocking decisions within the Critical Spares program
Define per-equipment MBOM standards in partnership with Field Engineering and equipment owners
Build mechanisms to maintain MBOM accuracy as new equipment deploys and the fleet evolves (including liquid cooling)
Drive cross-functional coordination across Availability, Field Engineering, DCEO, and lifecycle data teams
Use data and metrics to measure program health, prioritize effort, and communicate progress
Write narratives (one to six pages) and present to Director-level leadership
Travel up to 10%

A day in the life

You will split your time between program execution and cross-functional coordination. On any given day you might be reviewing AI pipeline output quality with the tooling team, defining MBOM standards for a new equipment type with Field Engineering, working with a vendor to obtain documentation for legacy equipment, analyzing coverage gaps to prioritize the next tranche of MBOMs, or presenting program status and trade-off decisions to leadership. You will operate at both the strategic level - setting the roadmap for fleet-wide MBOM completeness - and the tactical level - digging into specific equipment families where data doesn't exist.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of technical product or program management experience
3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
2+ years of analytical, quantitative, communication, and presentations experience
2+ years of experience with bill of materials, spare parts management, or enterprise asset management (CMMS/PLM) systems

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, etc.
Knowledge of data center infrastructure design, operations, or delivery
Experience working closely with development and business teams to communicate problem impacts and to understand business requirements
Experience interpreting technical or engineering documentation such as drawings, parts lists, vendor manuals, or specifications
Experience operating or managing AI/ML-assisted tools, automation pipelines, or data engineering workflows
Experience working with vendor technical teams or OEM partners

Description

Our organization spans three distinct Amazon India businesses — Amazon Business (comprising Self-Service Registered / SSR and CPS enterprise sales), Private Brands, and ReCommerce — each on a multi-million-dollar, WW-leading growth trajectory. We are hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager to own the most critical and complex programs across the portfolio, with a primary focus on Amazon Business (SSR and CPS) and targeted support for the largest, highest-complexity programs in Private Brands and ReCommerce. This is a senior, cross-cutting role spanning three separate businesses: you will drive alignment across engineering, product, and business leaders.Many of these programs are customer-facing AI products; others are platform, pricing, expansion, supply-chain, or compliance programs — you will own the hardest ones regardless of type.

You will inherit a portfolio of the org's marquee initiatives. Success looks like complex programs delivered on time across team boundaries, dependencies sequenced before they become blockers, and leadership given a single, trusted view of program health.

Own the largest and most complex programs in Amazon Business (SSR and CPS) — the primary focus of the role — driving them end-to-end from definition through launch across engineering, product, pricing, GTMO/sales, and operations. These span customer-facing AI products as well as platform, pricing, expansion, and compliance programs.

Lead delivery of customer-facing AI experiences where they are on the critical path — turning fast-moving AI capabilities into shipped products with clear customer value — while applying the same rigor to the org's other complex, high-stakes programs.

We are looking for a Program Manager to own external supply chain loss prevention in Europe across Amazon Freight, Ship with Amazon (SWA), and WePay inbound shippers. This role is based in the UK and requires someone who can build relationships on the ground with EU Field Loss Prevention, Investigations, Ship with Amazon Operations, and Surface Transport teams. You will own the full portfolio of security solutions for EU external supply chain from smart lock pilots and seal programs to tool integrations and enterprise shipper launches. You will operate with significant autonomy while aligning to a global framework.

Key job responsibilities

Own our EU loss prevention strategy, solutions, and execution
Drive Ship with Amazon EU tool parity with Amazon Fulfillment Network : Shrink Theft Identification Platform, Unified network investigations tool ecosystem, ...
Develop and execute theft mitigation plans based on data and trends
Manage WePay inbound shipper security: New shipper onboarding, compliance enforcement, carrier vetting, seal management, and security audits
Partner with the High Value Shipper Security Strategist on EU enterprise shipper launches
Own the EU Ship with Amazon claims dashboard and weekly dive-deep report
Coordinate cross-border law enforcement engagement and investigation support
Build and maintain relationships with various teams and EU partners
Contribute to MBRs and QBRs with EU-specific metrics and insights

A day in the life

Your morning starts with the Ship with Amazon EU claims dashboard, flagging new loss spikes to the dive-deep report. Mid-morning you're on a call with EU Field Loss Prevention aligning on an Italy theft cluster, then reviewing lock pilot data from the UK lane. After lunch you're drafting the TAPA L2 compliance audit for a WePay inbound shipper, followed by a working session with the Ship with Amazon EU Ops team on making supervised unload a standard. You close the day syncing with the team in America debriefing and best practice sharing across borders.

The External Supply Chain team protects Amazon's freight and parcel movements across Amazon Freight, Ship with Amazon, and WePay inbound shippers globally. These businesses serve a range of models (business to business, business to customer, and customer to customer) where volume moves through third-party carriers, shipper warehouses, terminals, and Amazon's own network with limited visibility. The team designs, pilots, and scales solutions (seals, supervised handoffs, IoT tracking, tiered shipper security frameworks) that close visibility and chain-of-custody gaps where Amazon has historically had the fewest controls. Success is measured in loss dollars reduced, claims prevented, Network Standards established, and shipper trust earned as a competitive differentiator.

You will partner with stakeholders to review security related documentation and help them understand how physical security standards and policies apply to their real-world environment.

This role requires a professional who can draw on operational knowledge to lead projects, identify security gaps, develop practical and effective documentation, and drive solutions that continuously raise our security bar.

You will drive consistency, compliance, and operational excellence through best-practice standards and security system evaluation.

The right person for this role will;

Develop and review new technology and security measures, enhancing the security posture of our sites.
Lead projects that raise the security bar or address identified security risks — from technology gaps to operational shortfalls.
Apply your security operations expertise to create policies and standards and process documentation across multiple high-security sites.
Identify where current equipment or processes are not fit for purpose and lead initiatives to evaluate and implement new technology or solutions.
Ensure documentation reflects best practice grounded in real on-site operations — not just theory.
Build governance frameworks that keep security documentation current, approved, and aligned with global updates whilst remaining practical for on-site operations.
Continuously raise the security bar by identifying gaps, inefficiencies, emerging risks, and opportunities for development through the documentation and projects you own.
Be the authority on documentation standards within a growing infrastructure security organisation — combining operational credibility with process discipline.

If you have the security background to know what works in practice, the leadership skills to drive cross-functional projects, and the rigour to turn it all into scalable, consistent standards, we want to hear from you.

This role is responsible for driving the strategy and delivery of authentication products that span frontend, backend, customer data, and relationship management tools. You will partner with stakeholders across our larger security org, Customer Service, user experience, and engineering to create scalable technology that can flex to meet the demands of our rapidly developing business.

Key job responsibilities

Manage the lifecycle of complex cross-functional programs with considerable impact.
Deliver and maintain the overall strategy, driving teams inside and outside of the organization to deliver results.
Design the next generation of customer service authentication systems, meeting the needs of the future of the business.
Gain consensus across teams in the security organization and the business. Influencing without authority, always seeking to enable the business securely.
Provide context for business/technology choices with a lens to long-term value.
Communicate effectively at multiple levels of management, building trust across the organization, and demonstrating discretion with sensitive information.
Break abstract goals into attainable, measurable work items.

On any day, you monitor progress of cross-organizational programs that include both software development and projects. You’ll meet with Product Managers and engineering teams to drive changes to our roadmaps, making tradeoff decisions and deeply understand their impacts. In order to make this happen, our team develops the product roadmaps, engineering platforms and systems enabling access that drives efficiency, enforces least privilege and enables our customers and partners to operate securely by default.

jobs.description:
Job Description

What if you could shape a career as unique as you?

At WSP, you can always find opportunities to grow and do what matters to you. Make the most of our global reach to discover new challenges and chances to work with diverse, talented individuals who will help you expand your horizons.

A Little More About The Role…

WSP’s Project Security Managers sit within the Security Management function and deliver security assurance to all projects within their respective government sector. This could be Defence, Nuclear, or any other Government departmental area. They are responsible for complete security assurance for all prospects and projects with the aim of protecting our client’s most sensitive assets.

As a Project Security Manager, you will play a key role in providing an excellent security assurance service to our clients while identifying improvements to existing security programmes and processes. The role will manage all aspects of classified project delivery across the domains of Personnel, Physical and Information Security. You will be the focal point for all security assurance activity within your respective sector, providing targeted security direction and guidance as required.

Key responsibilities

Regular liaison with client security and project delivery teams in interpreting, implementing, and monitoring client security requirements as outlined in contractual security schedules or Security Aspects Letters (SALs).
Supporting the security accreditation and certification process for all external compliance requirements associated with your respective sector.
Supporting the development and implementation of governance and processes associated with security assurance for your respective sector.
Planning and delivery of assurance activities as required by contractual obligations, including but not limited to induction briefings, project-specific security briefings, supplier onboarding, and security awareness training.
Measuring and assessing the performance and effectiveness of security controls, identifying and implementing solutions where corrective action and improvements are needed.
Reviewing the competencies of WSP’s supply chain in all security assurance domains: Personnel, Physical and Information.
Collaborating with business areas in the identification, management, and mitigation of risks to WSP and its clients.
Supporting the development and maturity of WSP’s Security Management System.
Supporting investigations for all security incidents, including near misses, reported within your respective sector.

What We Will Be Looking For You To Demonstrate…

Hold SC clearance or the ability to achieve it.
Experience as a security manager or security controller in a regulated sector (e.g. Defence/Nuclear) is desirable.
Demonstrable knowledge of HMG security documentation (e.g. GovS:007), frameworks, policy and controls is essential.
Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to influence peers and seniors on matters concerning project security compliance and assurance.
Knowledge of risk management methodologies and practical experience of application.
Excellent organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workload and deliver to tight timescales.
A highly motivated and driven individual who adopts a flexible and adaptable approach.

Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Apply, and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities within the team.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?

With us, you can.
Apply today.

About Us

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Work-life balance

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.

Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

Inclusivity & Belonging

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity.

Health & Wellbeing

We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme.

Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package.

Flex your time

To enhance work-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day.

We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.

Your development

We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership.

#WeAreWSP

Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. As a Disability Confident leader, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria, please let us know if you require any workplace adjustments in support of your application.

jobs.description:
Overview

Bring your project management experience. Support secure delivery. Make an impact.

At AtkinsRéalis, our Project Managers help bring structure, control and confidence to secure, complex delivery. You'll help manage the deliverables, commitments and contractual obligations we have with our clients, with accountability matched to your capability, experience and the scale of assignment. You'll join a collaborative delivery community and work alongside project, technical, commercial and transformation specialists who valueclear thinking, reliable controls, good governance and shared learning.

We are recruiting for multiple Project Manager roles across a range of capability and accountability levels. We welcome candidates with experience managing delivery in supplier-side, consultancy or complex internal delivery environments, particularly where this involves contractual commitments, client-facing governance and delivery against agreed outcomes. We are also open to applications from people looking for part-time or flexible working arrangements.

You'll Benefit From

Purpose-driven work at the heart of secure-government delivery.
Hybrid working, with time onsite to build relationships, access secure systems and operate effectively in high-integrity environments.
Opportunities to build your project delivery capability and take on broader accountability as your experience grows.
Training, tools and frameworks to support planning, governance, risk, assurance, commercial management and project controls.
A supportive delivery community with access to experienced colleagues, mentoring and practical development opportunities.

Your role

As a Project Manager within our Delivery Optimisation sub-practice, you'll work in secure, client-facing supplier delivery environments where structure, judgement and reliable controls matter. The scope of each role will reflect your experience, from managing defined deliverables or smaller projects through to taking broader accountability for more complex contracted assignments.

You may define delivery roles and ways of working, manage plans, schedules, risks, quality arrangements and reporting, and monitor progress against cost, schedule, quality, commercial and contractual commitments.
You may also manage suppliers, partners or internal delivery teams, support client-facing governance, and identify opportunities to strengthen delivery, resolve issues and add value within the scope of our contracted work.
For more complex assignments, you may coordinate multi-disciplinary delivery teams, manage dependencies and support the successful delivery of agreed outputs, outcomes and benefits.

All our roles are subject to a minimum of 3 days in the office, either onsite with our clients or at one of our AtkinsRéalis offices, pro-rated for part-time employees. We are open to discussing flexible and part-time working patterns where these can support both the role requirements and individual circumstances.

About You

Project management experience in supplier-side, consultancy or complex internal delivery environments.
Experience supporting or leading project activities such as planning, governance, reporting, risk, assurance, finance, commercial management, change or delivery control.
The ability to work with data, delivery tools and project information to support effective decision-making.
Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with project teams, stakeholders, suppliers and clients, particularly where expectations, deliverables and responsibilities need to be managed carefully.
Commercial awareness, including budgets, forecasting, cost control, change control and contractual commitments appropriate to the role.
An understanding of project delivery lifecycles, governance and the importance of robust controls in complex environments.
A proactive, collaborative and considered approach, with the judgement and professionalism to operate effectively in secure, client-facing supplier delivery environments.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

Be rewarded. Find out more.

About AtkinsRéalis

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Find out more.

The Senior Cybersecurity (CS) Project Manager is responsible for all aspects of project management for high complexity, high enterprise impact, and high visibility project(s) over the entire life of the initiative. The Senior CS Project Manager understands complicated business objectives and scope and assembles a team to deliver superior results for their project(s). The Senior CS Project Manager works closely with accountable delivery Leaders in the CS, IT and other business unit organizations to ensure assigned project(s) deliver on business objectives and value, while managing scope/timeline/budget and technical risk. The Senior CS Project Manager is responsible for multiple complex projects at one time. This position requires strong knowledge of Cybersecurity technology processes and implementation procedures and proven leadership skills to provide the necessary structure around key strategic initiatives and high impact transformative enterprise-wide projects.

Responsibilities

Job Duties/Responsibilities (in addition to Project Manager job duties):

Manage high impact, complex, and enterprise-level strategic projects through the project life cycle. Engage stakeholders including management and senior leadership across multiple business units to drive buy-in and delivery of transformative projects.
Ensure excellent outcomes by utilizing project management processes, methodologies, and techniques, and contribute to process improvements and knowledge sharing. Drive process excellence in project management methodologies to promote execution effectiveness.
Support business functional leaders in the development and execution of strategic initiatives.
Lead cross-functional teams in the planning and execution of business-critical projects.
Apply appropriate level of process rigor to facilitate change control decisions which impact project scope and deliverables and drive alignment of key stakeholders.

Relationship builder, influential and strategic partner (business partner).

Description

The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Data Center Security Team is seeking a highly talented and motivated Security Program Manager to join our team in Israel

At Amazon, we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.

After a successful application, you will contribute to the design, installation and integration of security systems equipment including, but not limited to, Access Control/Intrusion Detection and CCTV Surveillance systems. You will also be responsible for preventative maintenance and repair of security systems equipment.

You will be required to work in all related disciplines, at all levels; from technology research to system design and layout, oversight of construction and implementation, as well as maintenance and upgrades over the life of the system. You will need to have an in-depth knowledge of security technology, to be innovative, highly organized, and to have demonstrated the ability to deliver results on time and within budget.

As a key member of the EMEA Security team, you will report to the Multi Cluster Security Program Manager

Your ultimate success will be measured by how you assist with the development, implementation and commissioning of standardized security infrastructure systems for the AWS region. This is measured by agreed upon objectives and metrics related to key areas such as the level and quality of customer service provided, access control effectiveness, and the protection of our customer data, employees and visitors. You will be responsible for observing Physical Security Standards and Programs that support the goals of the Global Physical Security Team, while enabling the local site managers to draw related services from the team, in a self-service manner.

This Includes

Excellent project management skills, with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment
Effective prioritization of tasks, and seamless operation across organizational boundaries
Execution and coordination of preventative maintenance and repairs to security system equipment
Ensuring compliance with physical security project standards, project Scopes of Work, budgets and timelines
Designing, developing, and implementing solutions for system installations, upgrades, repairs and change outs
Supporting security system equipment commissioning
Completing final Test and Acceptance of security systems
Building and deploying training programs for all users of physical security systems

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
